question: What must happen when a serialized module interface or one of its cache inputs is unavailable or inconsistent?
decision: Reject the sidecar for that module and fall back to ordinary source parsing; retain independently valid lower dependency sidecars and preserve the existing file-aware diagnostics.

fallback_contract.graph: the parsed importer source remains authoritative for its import/re-export edges
fallback_contract.partial_reuse: valid lower dependencies remain preloaded when an importer sidecar is rejected
fallback_contract.diagnostics: source parse errors retain the existing file-aware path and ranges
fallback_contract.valid_hit: unchanged valid sidecars continue to omit dependency statement bodies

compatibility_boundary.cdbc: cdbc 0.1 module and linked artifacts unchanged
compatibility_boundary.fallback: missing or invalid cache data never changes source visibility or diagnostic stage

migration: Add deterministic frontend regression coverage beside the valid-hit test, retain source fallback, and defer deletion until the complete inventory proves visibility and diagnostic parity.
old_path_deletion_condition: Remove source fallback only after direct, namespace, re-export, search-path, and repeated-build inventory cases show zero unexplained differences across valid and invalid cache states.
